boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Lake Forest College
boards.description: Ten currently documented food and snack destinations with evening or later availability on campus and in Lake Forest/nearby Highwood.

cards.title: Boomer’s
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center, Lake Forest College
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of Mohr Student Center when you need food late; verify any break-period changes before going.
cards.short_summary: Campus food service listed through midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College lists Boomer’s food service until midnight Monday–Friday and noon–midnight Saturday–Sunday during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year food service: Mon–Fri 11 a.m.–midnight; Sat–Sun noon–midnight. Limited alcohol service is separately restricted to adults 21+.

cards.title: The Market at Boomer’s
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center, Lake Forest College
cards.notes: Use the lower-level market for a late campus snack or drink; check the College dining page during academic breaks.
cards.short_summary: A campus market with midnight academic-year closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College lists The Market at Boomer’s open until midnight daily during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–midnight; Sat–Sun 10 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Deerpath Cafe
cards.subtitle: Deerpath Hall, North Campus
cards.notes: Stop by Deerpath Hall for a late snack on North Campus; the College lists the cafe as open every day during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A North Campus snack option scheduled through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College describes Deerpath Cafe as late-night snacks on North Campus and lists it open daily from 8 p.m. to midnight during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: seven days a week, 8 p.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Cyber Cafe
cards.subtitle: Donnelley and Lee Library, Lake Forest College
cards.notes: Pair an evening library visit with coffee, juice, fruit, or baked goods; weekday closing is earlier than the midnight campus options.
cards.short_summary: Library-based café open to 10 p.m. on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College lists Cyber Cafe on the first floor of Donnelley and Lee Library and gives 10 p.m. closing times Monday–Thursday and Sunday during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: Mon–Thu 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sun 5–10 p.m. Closed Saturday; Friday closes at 2 p.m.

cards.title: The Paw
cards.subtitle: Sports and Recreation Center, Lake Forest College
cards.notes: Pick up a smoothie, sandwich, fruit, or protein shake after recreation-center activities, keeping the listed 9 p.m. weekday close in mind.
cards.short_summary: A recreation-center food counter with weekday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College says The Paw is on the first floor of the Sports and Recreation Center and lists weekday hours until 9 p.m. during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–9 p.m.; Sat–Sun 9 a.m.–8 p.m.

cards.title: Oaken Bistro + Bar
cards.subtitle: 200 N Field Drive, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Choose a dinner or takeout stop at the Forester Hotel; its official site lists kitchen service through 10 p.m., separate from the later venue close.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Forest restaurant whose kitchen is listed through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Oaken Bistro + Bar lists daily hours of 6:30 a.m.–11 p.m. and states that its kitchen closes at 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 6:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; kitchen closes at 10 p.m.

cards.entity_name: The Market at The Forester Hotel
cards.title: The Market at The Forester Hotel
cards.subtitle: 200 N Field Drive, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Use the hotel’s grab-and-go market for packaged snacks, salads, pastries, or drinks at any hour; it is a separate destination from Oaken.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 grab-and-go market in Lake Forest.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forester Hotel identifies The Market as a 24/7 grab-and-go market with snacks, salads, pastries, and sweets.
cards.source_title: Eat + Drink at The Forester Hotel | Lake Forest, IL
cards.access_notes: Official hotel dining page lists The Market hours as 24/7.

cards.title: Lou Malnati’s Lake Forest
cards.subtitle: Lake Forest, Illinois
cards.notes: Plan a carryout or delivery pizza order with the location’s day-specific closing times; Friday and Saturday extend to 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Forest carryout and delivery pizza option open until 11 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Lou Malnati’s lists its Lake Forest location as carryout and delivery only, closing at 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. on other listed days.
cards.access_notes: Tue–Thu and Mon 4–10 p.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Carryout and delivery only.

cards.title: The Lantern
cards.subtitle: 768 N Western Avenue, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Use the family restaurant’s kitchen hours for an evening meal; kitchen service ends at 10 p.m., before the separate bar hours.
cards.short_summary: A Lake Forest family restaurant with a kitchen open daily until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lantern’s official site says it has served families since 1934 and lists its kitchen open every day from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen open daily 11 a.m.–10 p.m. The business separately lists bar hours; this card is limited to kitchen service.

cards.title: Froggy’s French Café
cards.subtitle: 306 Green Bay Road, Highwood
cards.notes: For an earlier late-evening dinner in nearby Highwood, check the official reservation page and choose a night with the listed 9 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Highwood restaurant serving dinner until 9 p.m. on its listed nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Froggy’s French Café lists dinner hours of 5–9 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday and Friday–Saturday at its Highwood location.
cards.access_notes: Dinner: Tue–Thu 5–9 p.m.; Fri–Sat 5–9 p.m. Closed Sunday and Monday.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase campus and nearby activities with direct access evidence for Lake Forest College students.

cards.title: Settle into the Skybox Lounge
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center
cards.notes: Bring a friend, use the seating, tables, or TV, and check whether an organization has reserved the lounge after 4 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge for an easy daytime or evening pause.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College says students are welcome to use the Skybox Lounge and that during the day they are free to use it.
cards.access_notes: For Lake Forest College students; organizations may reserve the space after 4 p.m.

cards.title: Take a break in the CCP Lobby
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center
cards.notes: Use the lobby to rest, relax, or do homework; keep in mind that the office is working there during the day.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed Mohr Student Center stop that remains open into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College says students may freely use the Center for Chicago Programs lobby to rest, relax, and do homework.
cards.access_notes: For Lake Forest College students; the lobby is open through the evening after the offices close.

cards.title: Meet up in Calvin Durand Hall
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center
cards.notes: Choose this public campus space for a low-key conversation or homework session, then leave it ready for the next group.
cards.short_summary: A publicly usable space inside the Mohr Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College identifies Calvin Durand Hall in Mohr Student Center as one of the public campus spaces students are welcome to use.
cards.access_notes: For Lake Forest College students.

cards.title: Choose a library study spot
cards.subtitle: 555 North Sheridan Road, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Pick an individual, collaborative, or group-study space and use the library as a quiet anchor for a planned meet-up.
cards.short_summary: Study and collaboration spaces at the center of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College lists the Donnelley and Lee Library among public campus spaces students are welcome to use and describes individual, collaborative, and group study spaces.
cards.source_title: Donnelley and Lee Library | Lake Forest College
cards.access_notes: For Lake Forest College students; building hours are listed separately by the College.

cards.entity_name: Brown Hall Collaboration and Quiet Spaces
cards.title: Work together in Brown Hall
cards.subtitle: Brown Hall, Middle Campus
cards.notes: Find an available collaboration or quiet space for a group task, and check first if a room needs a reservation.
cards.short_summary: Flexible Brown Hall spaces for quiet work or collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College states that Brown has collaboration and quiet spaces for student use and that most are available without a reservation.
cards.access_notes: For Lake Forest College students; most spaces are available without reservation.

cards.title: Use the Art Institute student admission
cards.subtitle: 111 S. Michigan Ave, Chicago
cards.notes: Bring your Lake Forest College ID and confirm current entry details with the College before traveling to the museum.
cards.short_summary: A College partnership provides student museum access without an admission purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College states that its students enjoy free admission to the Art Institute of Chicago 365 days a year through the University Partner relationship.
cards.source_title: College and Art Institute unite for cultural exploration | Lake Forest College
cards.access_notes: Lake Forest College student ID is required; verify museum entry procedures before the visit.

cards.title: Join First Connection before orientation
cards.subtitle: Lake Forest College campus
cards.notes: Eligible new students can use this pre-orientation program to meet peers and mentors while getting acquainted with campus.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost pre-orientation program for newly admitted students.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College says First Connection is free for participants and provides all activities and meals free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For newly admitted students participating in the pre-orientation program; the College lists August 19, 2026 move-in.

cards.title: Reserve a student theater ticket
cards.subtitle: Hixon Theater, South Campus
cards.notes: Check the theater page for the next production, reserve early when required, and bring College affiliation for the $0 ticket.
cards.short_summary: Campus theater performances with $0 tickets for College students.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College lists tickets for its theater production as $0 for Lake Forest College students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: For Lake Forest College students, faculty, and staff; confirm the current production and reservation availability.

cards.title: Walk to Fort Sheridan’s lake overlook
cards.subtitle: Fort Sheridan Forest Preserve, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Follow the short paved Lake Overlook Trail from the Gilgare Lane lot and use the viewing area for a shoreline reset.
cards.short_summary: A paved walk to Lake Michigan views from a 70-foot bluff.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake County Forest Preserves describes Fort Sheridan as offering free public access to Lake Michigan and identifies the paved Lake Overlook Trail.
cards.source_title: Fort Sheridan Forest Preserve | Lake County Forest Preserves
cards.access_notes: Open daily 6:30 a.m. to sunset; use the Gilgare Lane parking lot for the Lake Overlook Trail.

cards.title: Walk Fort Sheridan’s Lake Michigan shoreline
cards.subtitle: Fort Sheridan Forest Preserve, Lake Forest
cards.notes: Stay on the permitted shoreline stretch, bring only what you carry out, and skip swimming, wading, and boating at this preserve.
cards.short_summary: A lakefront walk with free public access and a designated sandy shore.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake County Forest Preserves says Fort Sheridan offers free public access to Lake Michigan and permits walking along a 0.75-mile sandy shoreline stretch.
cards.source_title: Fort Sheridan Forest Preserve | Lake County Forest Preserves
cards.access_notes: Open daily 6:30 a.m. to sunset; swimming, wading, and boating are not allowed.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Lake Forest College study environments, spanning quiet library settings, reservable rooms, and shared campus lounges.

cards.entity_name: Donnelley and Lee Library Cozy Corners
cards.title: Settle into a library corner
cards.subtitle: Donnelley and Lee Library
cards.notes: Bring independent reading or a laptop and choose one of the library’s cozy corners; use the library’s listed building hours to plan your visit.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, individual-work option inside the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College directs students seeking a quiet environment to “cozy corners” in Donnelley and Lee Library.
cards.access_notes: Library building hours are listed as 8 a.m.–11 p.m., seven days a week; verify holiday or break changes before going.

cards.entity_name: Donnelley and Lee Library Basement Quiet Zones
cards.title: Use the library’s basement quiet zones
cards.subtitle: Donnelley and Lee Library basement
cards.notes: Head downstairs when you need a quieter setting for focused reading or writing, then select a quiet zone that suits your work session.
cards.short_summary: Library basement areas identified by the College as quiet zones.
cards.evidence_claim: The College states that the Donnelley and Lee Library basement offers many quiet zones.
cards.access_notes: Available to Lake Forest College students; check the library’s building-hours page for current access times.

cards.entity_name: Donnelley and Lee Library Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a library study room
cards.subtitle: Donnelley and Lee Library
cards.notes: Book a room through the College library’s reservation link when you need a contained place to concentrate or work with a small group.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for planned study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College states that library study rooms are available for reservation through the Lake Forest College Library website.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; use Lake Forest College Library’s room-reservation system and follow its current policies.

cards.entity_name: Donnelley and Lee Library 24-Hour Computer Lab and Study Space
cards.title: Plan an after-hours computer session
cards.subtitle: Donnelley and Lee Library
cards.notes: Use this option for computer-based work outside normal library building hours; bring your College ID for after-hours building entry.
cards.short_summary: A College-ID-access study and computer space outside regular building hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The College lists a 24-hour computer lab and study space in Donnelley and Lee Library for its students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Lake Forest College students, faculty, and staff; College ID is required for after-hours entrance.

cards.entity_name: Donnelley and Lee Library Café Side
cards.title: Use the library café-side study area
cards.subtitle: Donnelley and Lee Library
cards.notes: Choose the café side of the library for a longer study block, especially when you need a place available beyond regular daytime schedules.
cards.short_summary: A library-based study area identified as open 24 hours for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College states that the café side of the library remains open 24 hours a day for students to study.
cards.access_notes: For Lake Forest College students; consult current campus access information and carry your College ID for after-hours access.

cards.title: Check the Skybox before settling in
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center
cards.notes: Use the seating and tables for study when open, but confirm it has not been reserved for a student-organization meeting or program.
cards.short_summary: A student-center lounge that serves as a study and TV lounge when unreserved.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s Mohr Student Center policy says the Skybox remains open daily when not reserved for use as a study and TV lounge.
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on reservations; the College says the lounge is open daily when it is not reserved.

cards.entity_name: Brown Hall Group Study and Lounge Areas
cards.title: Meet in Brown Hall’s group-study areas
cards.subtitle: Brown Hall
cards.notes: Use one of Brown Hall’s group-study and lounge areas for collaborative work, then move to a different space if your group needs privacy.
cards.short_summary: Four designated areas for group study and lounging in Brown Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College states that Brown Hall has four areas for group studying and lounging.
cards.source_title: Brown Hall: The Newest Building on Campus
cards.access_notes: The College’s commuter-student guidance says most Brown Hall collaboration and quiet spaces are available without a reservation.

cards.title: Reserve a private Brown Hall room
cards.subtitle: Brown Hall
cards.notes: Reserve a private meeting room for a project meeting, practice session, or focused group work; use your Lake Forest sign-on information.
cards.short_summary: Six reservable private meeting rooms in Brown Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College states that Brown Hall includes six private meeting rooms available for reservation.
cards.source_title: Brown Hall: The Newest Building on Campus
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; the College directs students to use Lake Forest sign-on information for reserving campus space.

cards.title: Work from the Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Basement of Deerpath Hall
cards.notes: Commuter students can use this lounge as a campus base for homework or independent study; bring your student ID for building and lounge entry.
cards.short_summary: A designated Deerpath Hall study lounge for commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College identifies the Commuter Lounge in Deerpath Hall’s basement as a place commuters can study.
cards.access_notes: For commuter students; a student ID is needed to enter Deerpath Hall and then the lounge.

cards.title: Do homework in the CCP lobby
cards.subtitle: Mohr Student Center
cards.notes: Use the Center for Chicago Programs lobby for homework and expect daytime office traffic; the College says the space remains open into the evening.
cards.short_summary: A Mohr Student Center lobby open through the evening for homework.
cards.evidence_claim: Lake Forest College says students may use the Center for Chicago Programs lobby to rest, relax, and do homework, and that it is open through the evening.
cards.access_notes: The College notes that CCP offices operate there during the day, so anticipate foot traffic; the lobby is open through the evening.
